title: Consumer Product Safety Commission SWAT raid on United Nuclear
summary: Bob Lazar tells of Consumer Product Safety Commission SWAT raid on United Nuclear, about 2000s at Lazar's home, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: raided by the Consumer Product Safety Commission. They come in with a SWAT team with a machine woke my wife up out of bed with, you know, an M-16 pointed in her face.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he once worked on recovered flying craft at a secret site in Nevada, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a raid on his business, United Nuclear, sometime in the 2000s. Lazar says the Consumer Product Safety Commission, a US government agency that polices the safety of products sold to the public, came to his home with an armed tactical team, and that his wife was woken in bed with a rifle pointed at her face. He tells it as an example of how heavily the government has come down on him.
